name: MarketNow Skills API
description: Open marketplace for AI agent skills — MCP compatible. Every skill has a real description from its source repository.

endpoints.all_skills: /api/skills (paginated — the unpaginated /api/skills.json dump was removed 2026-09-25, returns a deprecation manifest)

usage.by_category: GET /api/skills?category=Finance — or filter client-side on skills-lite.json
usage.search: GET /api/search?q=weather — or filter client-side on the lite dataset

note_f06: 2026-09-25 (audit F-06 closure): /api/skills.json (94MB) removed; use paginated API or /api/skills-lite.json
